package rulefixtures

import "reflect"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_hot_path_optimization_reflection_on_hot_path: Layer: Hot path optimization. Flag reflect-based field access in hot loops where typed access is available.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

type Event struct {
	Type   string
	Source string
	Data   map[string]string
}

func FilterEvents(events []Event, field string, value string) []Event {
	var result []Event
	for _, ev := range events {
		rt := reflect.TypeOf(ev)
		f, _ := rt.FieldByName(field)
		v := reflect.ValueOf(ev)
		fieldVal := v.FieldByIndex(f.Index).String()
		if fieldVal == value {
			result = append(result, ev)
		}
	}
	return result
}
